title: REST controller design trace event state
description: Shape of the `state` field for rest-controller-endpoint-design trace events: the handler table of one controller plus the request currently going through it.

controller.description: Class name of the controller being designed, e.g. EmployeeController.

basePath.description: The URL prefix the controller owns, e.g. /employees.

entity.description: Name of the persistence type behind the resource; used to detect it crossing the HTTP boundary.

service.description: Name of the collaborator the handlers delegate to, derived from the controller name.

handlers.description: The declared handler methods, one entry per method+path, in declaration order.

key.description: Stable identifier of the handler: 'METHOD /path', also used in highlight tokens.

method.description: The HTTP method, untranslated (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE).

path.description: The URL template the handler is mapped to, e.g. /employees/{id}.

in.description: Request body type, or '-' when the method takes no body.

out.description: Response body type, or '-' when the method answers with no body.

status.description: The success status code this handler answers with.

statusLine.description: The same code as an HTTP status line, e.g. '201 Created'.

signature.description: The Java signature the design implies, derived from the path template, query parameters, body and status.

query.description: Query parameters the handler accepts (paging and filters), in declaration order.

validated.description: Whether constraints are declared on the request body of this handler.

logic.description: Business logic parked inside the controller method, or null when the handler only delegates.

issues.description: Design findings for this handler; the technical code only, the reason is in the event description.

current.description: Whether the request being processed was routed to this handler.

request.description: The request going through the controller (absent while the controller is only being designed).

method.description: The HTTP method the client sent, untranslated.

path.description: The path the client asked for, without the query string.

handler.description: Key of the handler the request landed on, or null when none is declared for it.

status.description: HTTP status line ('201 Created', '400 Bad Request'), or 'pending' while the request is still inside the controller.

stages.description: The four stages of a handler method, always in order: bind, validate, service, respond.

name.description: Technical stage code, translated by the visualizer.

state.description: How far this stage got for the current request.

detail.description: What happened in the stage: bound values, constraints, the service call, or the response.

handlerCount.description: How many handler methods the controller declares.

issues.description: Total number of design findings across all handlers.
